meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、查找、修复并美化项目里的界面组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常用代码搭建界面,想快速管理UI组件
copy.tagline_en: Add, find, fix, and style UI components in your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build interfaces with code and want an easier way to manage UI components.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 shadcn CLI 管理项目里的 UI 组件:添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式和组合界面(含聊天界面)。它会先读项目配置,按内置规则检查并修正组件代码,提供组件文档和用法示例。
howto.when: 当处理 shadcn/ui、组件注册表或 preset 代码时触发;当项目中有 components.json 文件或要求执行 'shadcn init' 等 preset 操作时也会触发。

howto.what_en: Claude manages project UI with the shadcn CLI: add, search, fix, debug, style, and compose UI (including chat). It reads config, follows built-in rules, and supplies docs and examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, or preset codes; also when a components.json file exists or the user asks for 'shadcn init' or similar preset operations.

Runs preset resolve to show config.
